# Oriel Zelkdale

Oriel Zelkdale is a Product Manager at Nexlet Robotics, focusing on automating roof condition scoring to accelerate insurers’ claims processing. Since joining Nexlet Robotics in 2021, Oriel has spearheaded the integration of the company’s catastrophe response platform into core insurance workflows, significantly enhancing real-time decision-making during flood and storm events.

Before Nexlet, Oriel led the rollout of the industry’s first cloud-based flood extent analytics system, dubbed Project Torrent, from 2017 to 2020. This system provided risk assessment teams with unprecedented rapid access to flood impact data, reducing exposure uncertainty by 30%.

Oriel specializes in bridging satellite imagery analytics with practical insurance applications, combining technical acumen with user-centric product design. Known for a collaborative and data-driven working style, Oriel partners closely with data scientists, field engineers, and customer success teams to ensure seamless deployment of solutions like the CatResponse integration tool.

Current employer: [[companies/nexlet-robotics]].
